CrossMux 1.6.1 for Waveshare ESP32-S3 ePaper 3.97 focuses on stable-only OTA, GitHub-hosted updates, and offline dictionary setup.

## Devices and installation

- OTA updates use the stable channel only; the nightly channel and its settings UI are removed.
- Firmware, manifests, and font packages are served from `github.com/dezzw/crossmux` releases (no `crossmux.com` dependency).
- The Firmware Release workflow publishes stable builds on semver tag pushes only.

## Reading and reliability

- Remove Wi-Fi dictionary download and the Manage Dictionaries settings flow; install StarDict dictionaries manually on the SD card.
- On load, legacy `otaNightlyEnabled` settings are ignored; the value is dropped on the next settings save.
- OTA and TLS code paths no longer reference `crossmux.com`.

## Firmware assets

- Stable builds ship as `waveshare-epaper-397-firmware.bin` with matching bootloader, partitions, boot_app0, manifests, and SHA-256 checksum files on GitHub Releases.
- Rolling tag `stable` carries the signed `waveshare-epaper-397-global-manifest.json` for OTA.
- Normal stable OTA updates preserve books and reading data on the SD card.

## 中文摘要

- 仅保留稳定版 OTA；已移除 nightly 频道及相关设置项。
- 固件、清单与字体均从 `github.com/dezzw/crossmux` 发布页获取，不再依赖 crossmux.com。
- 移除 Wi-Fi 词典下载与词典管理界面，请在 SD 卡手动安装 StarDict 词典。
- 旧版 nightly 开关在读取时被忽略，下次保存设置时自动清除。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dezzw/crossmux/compare/1.6.0...1.6.1
